title: Edward Teller on the UFO legacy program

tellings.quote: I vaguely remember some people suggesting that Edward Teller maybe was one of the maybe one of the physicists who if he if there is this legacy program he would be one

plain: The claim is that the physicist Edward Teller, best known for his work on nuclear weapons, may have been one of the scientists in a secret long-running US UFO effort called the legacy program, if such a program exists. A guest named Max says he vaguely remembers other people suggesting this. He does not say who they were.
